description.en-HK: Remove a text watermark from every PDF in a folder, keeping the folder structure.
description.zh-HK: 移除資料夾內所有 PDF 的文字水印，並保留資料夾結構。

text.en-HK:
Draft a Python regex that matches only the watermark in this page text, and nothing in the real content. Here is the page text I copied:

<paste the page text here>

<在此貼上頁面文字>
